Welcome to KinkDate.eu
notes: Publish the main welcome post on the KinkDate.eu Facebook Page. Introduce KinkDate as a new European community for adults 18+ interested in BDSM, kink and meaningful connections. Emphasize Explore. Connect. Belong. Pin the post.

title: What Makes a Dating Community Worth Joining?
notes: Publish a discussion question on Facebook asking what people value most in a dating/community platform: shared interests, conversations, finding people nearby, feeling comfortable, or something else. Focus on comments rather than direct promotion.

title: New to BDSM? You Don't Have to Know Everything
notes: Publish an educational Facebook post and matching website article about curiosity, learning, boundaries, communication and taking things at your own pace. Mention KinkDate naturally as a community for adults exploring these interests.

title: What Would You Want From a European Kink Community?
notes: Ask Facebook users what they would want to find in a new European kink community. Suggested options include profiles, conversations, educational content, European members, dating and friendship. Use the answers as market research.

title: Not Everyone Is Looking for a Relationship
notes: Create a Facebook post explaining that people may join a kink community for friendship, conversation, curiosity, dating or simply a sense of belonging. Finish with a soft KinkDate mention.

title: Find Relevant Facebook Groups
notes: Search for relevant Facebook groups such as BDSM Europe, BDSM Germany, BDSM UK, BDSM France, BDSM Netherlands, BDSM Greece, BDSM Spain, BDSM Italy, kink Europe, kink community, BDSM dating and alternative dating. Record each group, country, size, rules and whether promotion is permitted. Do not spam.

title: Research Relevant Reddit Communities
notes: Find relevant Reddit communities around BDSM, kink, BDSM dating, European dating, alternative relationships and BDSM communities. Read the rules and participate before promoting. Do not post KinkDate links unless the community permits self-promotion.

title: Which European Country Would You Start With?
notes: Ask Facebook followers which European country they would most like to meet like-minded adults in. Use the responses to identify potential priority markets.

title: Looking for an Alternative to Expensive Dating Sites?
notes: Create KinkDate.eu/alternatives. Explain that KinkDate is a new European community for adults 18+, free to join, focused on shared interests, profiles and connections. Do not attack competitors or make unverified claims.

title: BDSM Dating in Europe
notes: Create KinkDate.eu/bdsm-dating-europe with an informative article about finding people in Europe who share BDSM and kink interests. Education first; KinkDate as the natural community option.

title: Would You Join Before Paying?
notes: Ask Facebook users whether they would join a dating/community platform that lets them explore before committing to a paid subscription. Ask what they would expect to be available for free.

title: First Facebook Group Outreach
notes: In 2–3 groups where promotional posts are explicitly permitted, introduce KinkDate as a new European community and invite early members to help shape it. Keep the post genuine and non-spammy.

title: 5 Things Worth Discussing Before Meeting Someone Online
notes: Publish an educational Facebook post covering boundaries, expectations, consent, communication and personal safety. Position KinkDate as a responsible community without making unsupported safety guarantees.

title: Reddit Participation
notes: Contribute 5–10 genuinely useful comments in relevant Reddit communities. Do not promote KinkDate unless community rules permit it and the context is genuinely relevant.

title: Week 2 Review
notes: Record Facebook followers, reach, comments, shares, website visitors, registrations, registration sources, successful group opportunities and the posts that generated discussion. Use the results to adjust the next phase.

title: CollarSpace.eu — Build the European Resource
notes: Begin developing CollarSpace.eu as an independent European BDSM and kink community guide, if legally appropriate. Do not imitate CollarSpace.com or imply affiliation. Clearly distinguish the site from CollarSpace.com.

title: BDSM Communities in Europe — Where Do People Connect?
notes: Publish the first major CollarSpace.eu resource article discussing online communities, local groups, events, dating platforms, safety and finding compatible people. Introduce KinkDate only as a relevant newer European community.

title: What Makes a Good European Kink Community?
notes: Publish a KinkDate article discussing respect, consent, communication, diversity, privacy and meaningful connections across Europe.

title: What Would Make You Leave Your Current Platform?
notes: Ask Facebook users what problems would make them consider another dating/community platform: price, inactive profiles, poor mobile experience, fake profiles, difficulty finding nearby people, lack of European users or something else. Let users identify the problems rather than attacking competitors.

title: What People Actually Want From a Modern Kink Community
notes: Turn the answers from the previous discussion into an article summarizing what users say they want. Publish it on KinkDate.eu and, where appropriate, Facebook and CollarSpace.eu.

title: Competitor Research
notes: Create a research table covering relevant platforms, audience, European presence, free registration, main focus, publicly documented weaknesses or user complaints and potential KinkDate opportunities. Verify claims before publishing them.

title: Build Three Content Categories
notes: Organize KinkDate content into DISCOVER (searchable educational content), DISCUSS (questions and community conversations) and CONNECT (content that encourages registration). Rotate these categories instead of advertising every day.

title: You Don't Need a Label Before You Start Exploring
notes: Publish a Facebook post explaining that people can be curious and still be figuring themselves out. Encourage respectful exploration and mention KinkDate naturally.

title: BDSM Dating for Beginners
notes: Publish an educational article covering communication, boundaries, consent, profiles, meeting safely and taking things slowly. Keep it non-explicit and suitable for an adult educational audience.

title: Reddit Community Participation
notes: Participate in another 5–10 relevant Reddit discussions. Only mention KinkDate when self-promotion is allowed and the contribution is genuinely relevant.

title: Second Facebook Group Outreach
notes: Approach another 2–3 Facebook groups where promotional/community posts are explicitly allowed. Use a genuine introduction and avoid repetitive copy-and-paste promotion.

title: What One Feature Would You Insist On?
notes: Ask Facebook followers what single feature they would insist a new European kink community should have. Use the responses as product-development and marketing research.

title: What Users Told Us
notes: Summarize the useful responses from the feature discussion. Turn community feedback into a transparent article or Facebook post showing that KinkDate is listening to potential members.

title: Country Strategy
notes: Review registrations and engagement by country. Identify which European countries are showing the strongest early interest and prioritize those markets for future content.

title: First Country Landing Page
notes: Create a localized landing page for the strongest country identified from actual registration/engagement data, such as KinkDate.eu/bdsm-dating-germany. Do not choose a country based only on assumptions.

title: First Month Review
notes: Record Facebook followers, reach, comments, shares, website visitors, registrations, active profiles, returning visitors, strongest countries, best Facebook post, best article, best acquisition source, successful group opportunities, Reddit opportunities and CollarSpace.eu traffic. Use these results to plan Month 2.
